title: Spot silver after a 10-year bond shock it shrugged off (replication of gold-rates-shrug)
replicates: gold-rates-shrug T3 (OOS excess +0.072R, month t 1.90, Holm p 0.086)

rule.shock: 10-year bond CFD daily return / sd of the 250 previous common-day returns <= -1, and the named metal's same-day |z| < 0.5
rule.baseline: same side and hold entered at every silver candle of the same year (mean)
rule.costs: $0.06 a round trip on silver; no financing (no silver rate in council/fills.mjs FIN)

tests.what: bond price z <= -1 (yields up hard) and silver |z| < 0.5 the same day: buy silver at the next open, 1 candle (primary)

control.what: bond z shuffled among the days of each calendar year; the metal's days and its |z| < 0.5 filter kept

tests.what: bond price z <= -1 and GOLD |z| < 0.5 the same day: buy silver at the next open, 1 candle

control.what: bond z shuffled among the days of each calendar year; the metal's days and its |z| < 0.5 filter kept

tests.what: T1 event: buy silver at the next open, 5 candles

control.what: bond z shuffled among the days of each calendar year; the metal's days and its |z| < 0.5 filter kept
